description: FastAPI application defining endpoints for file uploads and serving an HTML form.

methods.name: create_files( files: list[bytes] = File(description="Multiple files as bytes"), )
methods.description: Handles POST request to /files/ endpoint, accepts multiple files as bytes and returns their sizes.

methods.name: create_upload_files( files: list[UploadFile] = File(description="Multiple files as UploadFile"), )
methods.description: Handles POST request to /uploadfiles/ endpoint, accepts multiple UploadFile objects and returns filenames.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Handles GET request to / endpoint, returns an HTML page with file upload forms.

ctags.name: create_files
ctags.signature: ( files: list[bytes] = File(description="Multiple files as bytes"), )

ctags.name: create_upload_files
ctags.signature: ( files: list[UploadFile] = File(description="Multiple files as UploadFile"), )
